description: Golden-set retrieval quality eval against a LIVE knowledge-search resource (KnowledgeSearchResource or HybridKnowledgeSearchResource), not a vector-index snapshot. Asset check fails below min_score or on regression vs the prior real eval.

outputs.description: No return value -- reports eval_summary/eval_results (or ad_hoc_question/ad_hoc_result) entirely as run metadata.

knowledge_base.label: Knowledge Base
knowledge_base.description: Optional UI-linking label only -- the knowledge base this evaluates. Not read or validated.

search_resource_key.label: Search Resource Key
search_resource_key.description: Dagster resource key of an already-registered KnowledgeSearchResource (knowledge_search_server) or HybridKnowledgeSearchResource (hybrid_knowledge_search_server) to query. A plain resource key, resolved the normal way -- not a special naming convention.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: The knowledge base's own base asset key, declared as a lineage dep (no data passed at runtime) so this eval re-evaluates whenever the base asset is rebuilt/updated.

golden_set.label: Golden Set
golden_set.description: List of {question: str, expected_terms?: [str], expected_sources?: [str]} dicts. expected_terms are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the top-k results' text; expected_sources are matched against each result's source, doc_id, OR chunk_id (any one matching counts). Either (or both) may be omitted per question.

min_score.label: Min Score
min_score.description: Absolute minimum mean score across golden_set. Asset check fails below this.

regression_pct.label: Regression Pct
regression_pct.description: Max allowed drop, in percentage POINTS of the 0-1 score (e.g. 10 = may not fall more than 0.10 below the prior real eval), vs the most recent PRIOR materialization that itself has eval_summary metadata -- an ad hoc {question} run's materialization is transparently skipped when walking back for this.
